question.en: How long had the police taken to find his bicycle?
question.zh: 警察花了多长时间找到他的自行车？

sentences.en: How long had the police taken to find his bicycle?
sentences.zh: 警察花了多长时间找到他的自行车？

sentences.en: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
sentences.zh: 丹·鲁滨逊焦虑了整整一个星期。

sentences.en: Last Tuesday he received a letter from the local police.
sentences.zh: 上星期二他收到当地警察局的一封信。

sentences.en: In the letter he was asked to call at the station.
sentences.zh: 信里要他去一趟警察局。

sentences.en: Dan wondered why he was wanted by the police, but he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried anymore.
sentences.zh: 丹不知道警察为什么要找他，但昨天他去了警察局，现在不再担心了。

sentences.en: At the station, he was told by a smiling policeman that his bicycle had been found.
sentences.zh: 在警察局，一位微笑的警察告诉他，他的自行车找到了。

chunks.x: by a smiling policeman that his bicycle had been found

sentences.en: Five days ago, the policeman told him, the bicycle was picked up in a small village four hundred miles away.
sentences.zh: 警察告诉他，五天以前，这辆自行车在四百英里外的一个小村子里被人捡到了。

chunks.x: the bicycle was picked up in a small village four hundred miles away

sentences.en: It is now being sent to his home by train.
sentences.zh: 现在正用火车给他运回家。

sentences.en: Dan was most surprised when he heard the news.
sentences.zh: 丹听到这个消息后非常惊讶。

sentences.en: He was amused too, because he never expected the bicycle to be found.
sentences.zh: 他也感到好笑，因为他从未指望还能找到这辆车。

chunks.x: because he never expected the bicycle to be found

sentences.en: It was stolen twenty years ago when Dan was a boy of fifteen!
sentences.zh: 那是二十年前被偷的，当时丹还是个15岁的孩子！

chunks.x: when Dan was a boy of fifteen
